meta.title: L2 Angkor — Furnished monthly rentals in Siem Reap
meta.description: Family-run, fully furnished apartments for long-term rent in Siem Reap, Cambodia. Monthly leases from 3 months, friendly hosts, fast Wi-Fi.

hero.title: A warm home for your time in Siem Reap
hero.subtitle: Fully furnished apartments for monthly rent, looked after by our family. Settle in, feel at home, and let us help with the rest.
hero.illustration: Illustration of Angkor temple towers, sugar palms and a Khmer house at sunset

about.title: More than a room — a place to belong
paragraphs: L2 Angkor is a small, family-run building in Siem Reap. We live on site and take care of every apartment ourselves, so you always have someone to ask — whether it's a broken light, the best noodle shop nearby or help with a visa question.
Many of our tenants are teachers, NGO workers and professionals who came for a few months and stayed for years. We'd love for you to feel the same.

payment.title: How to pay
payment.text: After we confirm your booking, you can pay the deposit by scanning the QR code or by bank transfer. Please send us a screenshot of the payment.

items.q: What is included in the rent?
items.a: Rent includes the furnished apartment, Wi-Fi and use of the shared facilities. Electricity and water are metered and paid separately each month.

items.q: How long is the minimum lease?
items.a: The minimum lease is 3 months. Longer leases are welcome, and we may offer a better price for 6 or 12 months.
The deposit is one month's rent. It is refunded when you move out, after we check the room together.

items.q: Can I see the room before I decide?
items.a: Of course. Visit us in person, or we can show you the room on a video call through Telegram, WhatsApp or WeChat.

items.q: Can you help with visas or a business visa extension?
items.a: We can't arrange visas ourselves, but we're happy to recommend trusted local agents and share what other tenants have done.
Sorry, we don't allow pets, to keep the rooms clean for everyone.
